attempted_claim: Complete backtracking census of monotone triangles with bottom row (1,...,n) yields exactly 42 (n=4), 429 (n=5), 7436 (n=6), 218348 (n=7), each agreeing exactly with both the direct MRR product evaluation and the Dodgson-condensation determinant evaluation, and an explicit maximal corner-sum monotone triangle at n=6 (and n=7) is exhibited with certified height value, all reproduced by a single replay command with logs in under two hours.
claim_type: product-formula equinumeration verification with height-function extremal witness and determinant certificate
decisive_failure: originality: Core equinumeration M(n)=42,429,7436,218348 and MRR product prod (3k+1)!/(n+k)! are fully anticipated: Mills-Robbins-Rumsey conjecture, Zeilberger 1994/96 general proof, Kuperberg 1996 square-ice proof, Fischer 2005 arbitrary-bottom-row operator formula, OEIS A005130 tabulation with product formula. Candidate admits MRR is assumed as oracle and general theorems are cited not reproved. Claimed delta is bundle novelty only: (a) Gram G=L diag(d) L^T with d_k=MRR(k+1)/MRR(k) is circular by construction — det G=MRR by det-multiplicativity since det L=1 — so triple-algorithm agreement tests determinant code, not ASM theory; draft admits it is a substituted constructed certificate after the remembered single-binomial determinant failed (det_3=11 vs 7). (b) Backtracker vs memoized DP share the same interlacing recurrence, i.e. software cross-check not mathematical independence. (c) Height H=sum of entries is trivial statistic; staircase extrema and C(n+2,3)/sum formulas are elementary; full per-height tables and palindromicity are raw computed observations without formula, proof, or conjecture; maximal witnesses are upper staircases mapping to identity permutation matrices (minimal to anti-identity) — trivial. No retrieved source combines this exact bundle, but combination of classical values with circular/trivial constructions is not a substantive mathematical delta. Failed-search/timestamp novelty does not establish priority. value: Not independently worth finding later. This is a verification certificate for already-proved classical initial values (general theorems cover all n; OEIS lists values to n>17), reproduced by brute force to n=7 in seconds. Falls squarely into SCOPE reject classes: textbook restatement (MRR numbers), circular parameter construction (Gram defined from MRR), and unexplained enumeration (per-height distributions of trivial sum statistic with no theorem, no closed form, no structural use; palindromicity reported only as observation). Maximal witnesses are trivial staircases/identities offering no insight beyond Lemma 1. Triple-determinant agreement and DP agreement are software-testing redundancies, not transferable methods. Honest limitations section states 'No new mathematics beyond Lemma 1/Corollary (elementary) is claimed.' Useful as a teaching/reproducibility exercise but not a publishable finding, OEIS-grade certificate need, or future retrieval target.

problem_statement: Independently verify ASM numbers for orders n=4,5,6,7 by exhaustive from-scratch monotone-triangle enumeration: generate all Gelfand-Tsetlin-type triangles with bottom row (1,...,n), strictly increasing rows and weak interlacing, count completions, and require exact equality to 42, 429, 7436, 218348; cross-check each value by exact-integer evaluation of the Mills-Robbins-Rumsey product prod_{k=0}^{n-1}(3k+1)!/(n+k)! AND by exact Dodgson-condensation evaluation of the ASM determinant; exhibit one explicit maximal corner-sum (height-function) monotone triangle at n=6 (and n=7 if reached) with certified height value; deliver a one-command replay script reproducing all counts and checks.
